entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for an order I placed last month.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered on November 20th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. The jersey is just the wrong size for me. I tried it on once and it's a bit too tight across the shoulders.
I understand completely. Getting the perfect fit is important. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, I've reviewed your order. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. Would you prefer a refund to your original payment method or would you like to exchange it for a different size?

That's great news. A full refund would be best. Since I have to go through the trouble of sending this back and placing a new order, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just to make the exchange process a bit smoother.

I appreciate you asking, and I understand why you would. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on returns for a sizing preference, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely free. I'm generating your pre-paid return label now and will email it to you. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Okay, free return shipping is fair. No problem. Please send over the label.

Perfect. The email is on its way to the address on file. Once our warehouse receives and processes the jersey, you can expect to see the refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day!
